metadata.description: Spec-driven code generation plugins for Augentic.

plugins.name: emery
plugins.description: Four skills over the Emery CLI: `/emery:specify` generates the reviewable `spec.md` / `design.md` / `plan.md` set from the named sources and stages it, `/emery:amend` stages a change against the sealed revision, `/emery:apply` seals what is staged in the target's repository, `/emery:build` builds the plan through a target adapter.
